name: Dealify

sources.title: Sell on Dealify page — LTD/deal marketplace pitch, commission-based model, 'Publish your deal' CTA

conditions: No upfront listing fee shown, but you must run a real discounted deal (lifetime, annual, credit-based, or freebie) and accept their commission on sales — 'Honest & Fair commissions' is the only pricing detail given
Not a directory listing — there is no free 'just list my product' option
requirements: A sellable digital product (SaaS/tool) that can absorb a deal: LTD, annual deal, credits, or freebie
Ability to honor deal terms — deal buyers on LTD platforms expect lifetime/deep-discount fulfillment
Products aimed at marketers/growth hackers/founders perform best (their stated audience)
preparation: Deal structure decision: lifetime vs annual vs credits vs freebie
Product assets: description, images, branding for the deal page
Support capacity for deal-driven user influx
workflow: Open https://dealify.com/pages/run-a-deal and use 'Publish your deal on Dealify' (JS-gated form/contact)
Pitch the product and proposed deal terms to their team
Negotiate commission and deal terms with Dealify
They run the promotion to their 50k+ customer base; you fulfill purchases
watchFor: Commission rate is not published — must be negotiated; 'the biggest piece of the pie is for you' is marketing language
LTD economics: lifetime deals create long-term support obligations for one-time revenue
This is a sales channel, not an SEO/listing play — backlinks are incidental
CTA buttons are '#' placeholders — actual intake is likely a JS form or email contact
countsAsLive: Your deal appears as a purchasable product page on dealify.com/products/<slug> under a collection
unknowns: Approval criteria and timeline for new deals
Whether a plain listing without a discount deal is possible
Payout schedule and refund handling (site advertises 30-day money-back to buyers)
